blocking.title: E4's preregistered outcome 'mutation score before and after' is not reported for the toybench repairs
blocking.location: prereg/0002-e1e2-audit.md:60 and :66; docs/REPORT.md:207-223 (section 5.5; template docs/templates/REPORT.md.in); README.md:47, :60; docs/claims/spec.json (no E4 mutation-score claim); artifacts/e4/toybench/summary.json mutation_scores
blocking.evidence: prereg/0002:60 (E4 repair, which explicitly covers the toybench tasks: 'toybench (E0) tasks with surviving variants are repaired the same way') says 'Report repaired, unrepairable (with reason), and rejected repairs, and mutation score before and after', and its stopping rule (:66) says 'Every preregistered outcome is reported.' REPORT 5.5 states 'E4 ran as preregistered in prereg/0002-e1e2-audit.md' and reports the repair counts and the generalization batch, but neither it, README.md, nor docs/cards/toybench.md reports the mutation score before or after repair. A grep for 'mutation score' in the three documents finds only the E0 mean, the method text, RQ6, and RQ4 (REPORT.md:28, 'Do synthesized checks raise mutation scores without adding false rejects'), which the report then never answers; docs/claims/spec.json has no E4 mutation-score claim. The data are banked: artifacts/e4/toybench/summary.json mutation_scores has 72 rows; over the 36 repaired tasks I computed a before mean of 0.767 (median 0.845, quartiles 0.679 and 0.913) and an after score of 1.0 on every one of the 36, which holds by construction because a repair is accepted only if it rejects every target and the wrapper rejects whatever the original grader rejects. Brief section 5 defines E4 as 'Measure the mutation-score gain and any change in false rejects'. This is the same class of omission as B6 of the previous review. Fix: render the before and after scores from mutation_scores as claims in REPORT 5.5 and the README E4 row, stating that 1.0 after repair on the original variants follows by construction, so the fresh batch is the informative measure.

blocking.title: G7 passes on any audit summary that cites any existing preregistration: E0's toybench rows citing prereg 0001 pass as E1/E2 on three public benchmarks
blocking.evidence: G7's property is 'E1 and E2 ran as preregistered on at least 3 benchmarks'. audit_check only requires that summary.json cite some existing file matching prereg/NNNN-<slug>.md, be marked confirmatory, carry provenance keys, have min(40, population) <= n_sampled <= n_tasks_population, and that its E1/E2 intervals recompute with the summary's own bootstrap seed. It never checks that the cited preregistration is prereg 0002 or its amendment (0003 now governs), that provenance.git_sha is the governing freeze commit (22b8832) with git_dirty false, that the audited task hashes are that benchmark's tasks in prereg/0002-sample.json, that the seeds are the preregistered 2027 (E1) and 2028 (E2) with B = 2000, or that the model store is the preregistered one; prereg-verify (G11) only dates the cited file against the data commits. Scratch test in a clone of 2d87aaa: I copied artifacts/e0/tasks.jsonl and variants.jsonl (synthetic toybench, 72 tasks) into artifacts/audit/{tau2,bfcl,humaneval}/ with summary.json copied from artifacts/e0/summary.json (prereg/0001-e0-tool-validity.md, git_sha 1629c30, seed 2026), changing only benchmark, category (tool-use for tau2), n_tasks_population 72, n_sampled 72, third_party true, and an evidence path under private/, and committed them. ship_check.g7_confirmatory_audit then returned Result(ok=True, 'E1 and E2 banked with recomputed intervals on 3 benchmarks: [bfcl, humaneval, tau2]'), and tools/prereg.py verify printed 'prereg-verify: OK (3 frozen, 5 confirmatory artifacts)'. So G7 can print PASS while no E1/E2 ran as preregistered, on synthetic data presented as public-benchmark results. G7 fails at HEAD only because no audit exists yet; this is the same class as B4 of the previous review (a gate taking an artifact's claims on trust), and it matters now because E1/E2 is running under prereg 0003. Fix: in audit_check, require the cited preregistration to be 0002 or the latest amendment in its 'Amends:' chain, provenance.git_sha to equal that file's freeze commit with git_dirty false, the task hashes to equal the benchmark's sampled tasks in prereg/0002-sample.json (whose SHA-256 is preregistered), the bootstrap seed and B to equal the preregistered values, and model_store to be the preregistered <benchmark>-0003 store; add this falsification scenario to tests/test_gates.py.
